an3.19:1.1: tīhi bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato pāpaṇiko abhabbo anadhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ adhigantuṃ, adhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ phātikattuṃ.
an3.19:1.3: idha bhikkhave pāpaṇiko pubbanhasamayaṃ na sakkaccaṃ kammantaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, majjhantikaṃ samayaṃ na sakkaccaṃ kammantaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, sāyanhasamayaṃ na sakkaccaṃ kammantaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
an3.19:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi aṅgehi samannāgato pāpaṇiko abhabbo anadhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ adhigantuṃ, adhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ phātikattuṃ. evameva
an3.19:2.1: kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo anadhigataṃ vā kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigantuṃ, adhigataṃ vā kusalaṃ dhammaṃ phātikattuṃ.
an3.19:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṃ na sakkaccaṃ samādhinimittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti. majjhantikaṃ samayaṃ na sakkaccaṃ samādhinimittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti. sāyanhasamayaṃ na sakkaccaṃ samādhinimittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
an3.19:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo anadhigataṃ vā kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigantuṃ, adhigataṃ vā kusalaṃ dhammaṃ phātikattuṃ.
an3.19:3.1: tīhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato pāpaṇiko bhabbo anadhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ adhigantuṃ, adhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ phātikattuṃ.
an3.19:3.3: idha bhikkhave pāpaṇiko pubbanhasamayaṃ sakkaccaṃ kammantaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, majjhantikaṃ samayaṃ …pe… sāyanhasamayaṃ sakkaccaṃ kammantaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
an3.19:3.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi aṅgehi samannāgato pāpaṇiko bhabbo anadhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ adhigantuṃ, adhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ phātikattuṃ. evameva
an3.19:4.1: kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhabbo anadhigataṃ vā kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigantuṃ, adhigataṃ vā kusalaṃ dhammaṃ phātikattuṃ.
an3.19:4.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu pubbanhasamayaṃ sakkaccaṃ samādhinimittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti. majjhantikaṃ samayaṃ …pe… sāyanhasamayaṃ sakkaccaṃ samādhinimittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti,
an3.19:4.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhabbo anadhigataṃ vā kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigantuṃ, adhigataṃ vā kusalaṃ dhammaṃ phātikattunti.
